project.name: Savage Wind Multiplayer
project.distribution: Savage Wind fork builds with native multiplayer compiled in
project.upstream_update_policy: project owner manually integrates new Savage Wind releases

architecture.transport_candidate: libdatachannel v0.24.6 for native M1 source builds
architecture.invite_flow: clipboard invite and reply, public STUN address discovery, direct ICE
architecture.integration: isolated multiplayer core with small build, settings, UI, runtime, and guest-site adapters

milestones.name: Native multiplayer build and internet lobby
milestones.scope: Owner accepted M1 after Windows and Linux clients joined a friend hosting on Linux. Hosting from the owner's network still requires diagnosis.
milestones.open_verification: owner-host direction, selected ICE candidates and full native acceptance matrix

milestones.name: Remote Link presence
milestones.scope: Nearby presence on the main field and in matching shrines, native idle/walk/run/sprint/jump, read-only health, and an independent release version. Windows verified 50 m spawn and 60 m retirement, retained the lobby through Slate travel and two shrine round trips, and held a four-game session for 90 seconds. Full fixture capacity was verified on one renderer.
milestones.manual_follow_up: The owner accepted M2 and deferred remaining manual validation to M7.

milestones.name: Time, weather, and full Link synchronization
milestones.scope: Synchronize host time and weather through one default-on multiplayer option, synchronize equipment and full animations, notify existing players with '[UserName] connected to the game' on admission, and add default-on overhead player names if feasible.
milestones.implemented_slice: Host time and weather, connection notices, revisioned melee, shield and bow slots, native bowstring states and all six inventory arrow visuals, grounded weapon and shield actions, lock-on dodges and landings, swimming, directional climbing and jumps, gliding with synchronized Link and canopy banking, buffered movement and gear playback, in-place grounded locomotion, standing-jump phase, and skinned default hair and equipped armor models.

milestones.name: Combat, enemies, and PvP
milestones.scope: Shared combat, enemies and PvP, plus remote player location markers on the in-game map screen.

milestones.name: Deferred manual validation
milestones.scope: Extended eight-game soak with late join and Leave cleanup, Linux AppImage build and verification against the matching Windows label, and mixed Windows/Linux visibility and Slate travel in both host directions.

animation_validation: Windows validation can happen during Appearance. The owner will validate Linux manually later and report any problems.
next_recommended_work: Fix remote armor palette matching and base skin clipping using the reproduction and checks in HANDOFF.md. Continue Traversal and reactions with native light and directional hits and movement transitions at water and ledges. Extend playback phase and rate beyond standing jumps. Airborne Link aim awaits layered playback.
